title: Stream Output
text: Write formatted ASCII data to communication channel, 1 input, 3 outputs; {Install new board} sets the register a board < no board, {Delete current board} sets the delete the current board, {Board setup} sets the up the board, {Sample time}, {Maximum missed ticks} sets the number of timer ticks by which your model can trail, {Show “Missed Ticks” port} sets the send number of missed ticks to port Missed, {Yield CPU when waiting} sets the yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware, {Input port sizes} sets the number and width of ports, {Format string} sets the format of data items being written, {Show “Data Ready” port} adds port Data Ready that signals 1 when the block can accept new, {Show “Data Error” port} adds port Data Error that signals 1 if error, {Initial string} sets the data to send when simulation begins character and {Final string} sets the data to send when simulation ends character. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Input Data
ports.summary: Data to write to communication channel numeric vector | string

params.name: Install new board
params.values: Register a board < no board selected > (default)

params.name: Maximum missed ticks
params.values: Number of timer ticks by which your model can trail the kernel 10 (default) | integer

params.name: Show “Missed Ticks” port
params.values: Send number of missed ticks to port Missed Ticks ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Yield CPU when waiting
params.values: Yield CPU while kernel waits for hardware ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Input port sizes
params.values: Specify number and width of ports 1 (default) | vector

params.name: Format string
params.values: Format of data items being written to the stream ’%g’ (default) | character vector

params.name: Show “Data Ready” port
params.values: Add port Data Ready that signals 1 when the block can accept new data ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Show “Data Error” port
params.values: Add port Data Error that signals 1 if error occurs ’off’ (default) | ’on’

params.name: Initial string
params.values: Data to send when simulation begins character vector

params.name: Final string
params.values: Data to send when simulation ends character vector
